\title{Entropy-Complete Plaquette Activities}\author{}\date{21 July 2026}\begin{document}\maketitle
\begin{abstract}We audit the corrected collar charge against radial integration entropy. The bare action criterion closes at the current coherence radius, while the entropy-complete Gaussian plaquette activity does not.\end{abstract}
For a three-component Gaussian curvature with $s=\rho^2/t$, the quadratic Chernoff rate is
\[J_3(s)=\frac12\left(s-3-3\log(s/3)\right),\qquad s>3.\]
The bare action exponent is $s/2$; their difference is the radial entropy cost.
\begin{theorem}For dependent projected Gaussian curvature, every connected $k$-plaquette event is bounded by $e^{-kJ_3(s)}$ without assuming independence. With Bianchi degree $D$, the rooted entropy-complete series converges only if
\[e^\alpha D^2e^{-J_3(s)}<1.\]
Its size-one rooted free energy is $J_3(s)-\alpha+\log(1-e^\alpha D^2e^{-J_3(s)})$.\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}The joint quadratic exponential moment yields the first factor. Multiplication by the connected-set bound $D^{2(k-1)}$ and the state weight $e^{\alpha k}$ gives a geometric series.\end{proof}
At the current coherent eta ceiling and $D=20$, the bare action series is subcritical but the entropy-complete series is supercritical. The executable inversion reports the larger curvature required for convergence and for free energy $6.71292101139$.
\begin{remark}This falsifies an action-only promotion. It is a Gaussian reference theorem; nonlinear normalized comparison remains open.\end{remark}\end{document}
